messages.subject: Re: launch_shinystan - error in b %*% data%Zt
parts:
So after masking the data to make it share-able here, I reran the model and no longer receive that specific error. My guess is that maybe it's related to the length of some of the factor level names, because that's the only thing that's changed about this data file compared to the one that generated the error.

However, the model still reports equivalent variances for all random effects. Any idea what's going on there, or should I start a new topic to address that?

library(rstanarm)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())

samp <- read.csv("rawdata.csv", header=TRUE)
samp$Yr <- factor(samp$Yr)
samp$Track <- factor(samp$Track)

fit <- stan_lmer(logP ~ 
                    Track
                  + logD
                  + logW
                  + logC
                  + (1|Yr)
                  + (1|SalesRep)
                  + (1|CustomerId)
                  + (1|OMkt:DMkt)
                  + (1|CarrierId)
                  , data = samp)

print(fit,digits=3)
launch_shinystan(fit)
